name: Higashiagatsuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashiagatsuma town emblem in blue: a disc with a ring notch beneath three wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Higashiagatsuma, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2007.

features.role: Higashiagatsuma town emblem — a disc with a ring notch beneath three wavy lines
